object: EXACT FUTURE-BEHAVIOR QUOTIENT / CARRIER OF CONNECTED-QALL EFFECT PROFILES

questions: Which pairs of D-profiles are distinguished by some authorized future R1 query?
Which pairs are distinguished by some authorized future R2 query?
Which pairs differ only in query-domain/live-identity availability but have the same future truth behavior on common live coordinates?
Which distinctions are required by reconstruction rather than solving semantics?

behavioral_equivalence.scope: Two canonical connected-QALL profiles are behaviorally equivalent only if all declared future authorized consumers receive exactly equivalent answers/updates after canonical identity correspondence on the common rooted source structure.
consumers: R1 forced-color truth on currently live vertices
R2 equal-color truth on currently live nonedge pairs
B2B1 successor canonicalization under every legal next force
behavioral_equivalence.domain_note: Difference in which original vertices remain live may distinguish query domains, but such a distinction is not by itself a superpolynomial representation obstruction if the live-set/domain is stored explicitly in polynomial space.

requirements: superpolynomially many future-distinguishable behavioral states after A/B/C/D reductions
distinguishability witnessed by authorized future consumers, not merely profile inequality
no polynomial-size exact carrier encoding the behavioral state
no polynomial query/update/reconstruction lifecycle on any sealed/proved carrier for the family/core
no secondary factorization or exact algebraic carrier closes the connected core

important_U1_firewall.statement: Exponentially many exact behavioral equivalence classes do not alone imply exponential representation size: k independently queryable bits already give 2^k quotient classes but admit an O(k)-bit explicit carrier.
important_U1_firewall.consequence: E must distinguish quotient-class count from carrier description/lifecycle complexity.

Kk_first_tests: Derive closed forms for R1 on surviving li and rj as functions of F.
Derive closed forms for R2 on same-side/cross-side nonedges as functions of F.
Determine whether these truth functions depend on all bits of F, only threshold/max(F), or another polynomial-size statistic.
Audit whether reconstruction needs more than the O(k)-size forced-assignment ledger already retained.
If Kk collapses to a polynomial carrier, classify it as a negative-control family despite its 2^(k-1) explicit profiles.
